_comment: Attachment mechanisms mined from Snow Peak's own product copy. Every entry quotes the sentence it came from. Parts the copy is silent about are NOT here -- they are listed as unknown and need a human.

S-029HA.note: Drops into the unit slots, between the two rails.
S-029HA.evidence: The half-unit size allows space for other grills, plates, or griddles.

CK-118TR.note: Hangs off the frame's edge on connection hooks, extending the layout. Usually needs its own legs -- it is a table, not a lid.
CK-118TR.evidence: Use it to extend the table 90 degrees to the left and create a wraparound cooking and dining space.

CK-119TR.note: Hangs off the frame's edge on connection hooks, extending the layout. Usually needs its own legs -- it is a table, not a lid.
CK-119TR.evidence: Use it to extend the table 90 degrees to the right and create a wraparound cooking and dining space.

CK-153TR.note: Slides into the ridges along the OUTSIDE of the frame rails. Needs no hook.
CK-153TR.evidence: The Renewed Bamboo IGT Sliding Extension does not require a hook, but slips into the ridges along the outside of the frame.

CK-154TR.note: Slides into the ridges along the OUTSIDE of the frame rails. Needs no hook.
CK-154TR.evidence: The Renewed Bamboo IGT Sliding Extension Long does not require a hook, but slips into the ridges along the outside of the frame.

CK-116TL.note: Hangs off the frame's edge on connection hooks, extending the layout. Usually needs its own legs -- it is a table, not a lid.
CK-116TL.evidence: The Bamboo IGT Table Regular Light can be attached to the IGT Frame or other extension with the already-attached connection hooks.

CK-116TR.note: Hangs off the frame's edge on connection hooks, extending the layout. Usually needs its own legs -- it is a table, not a lid.
CK-116TR.evidence: The Renewed Bamboo IGT Table Regular can be attached to the IGT Frame or other extension with the already-attached connection hooks.

CK-117TL.note: Hangs off the frame's edge on connection hooks, extending the layout. Usually needs its own legs -- it is a table, not a lid.
CK-117TL.evidence: To attach, insert the attached connection hooks into the IGT Frame and add legs to stabilize.

CK-117TR.note: Hangs off the frame's edge on connection hooks, extending the layout. Usually needs its own legs -- it is a table, not a lid.
CK-117TR.evidence: To attach, insert the attached connection hooks into the IGT Frame and add legs to stabilize.

CK-220.note: Hangs off an edge, below the surface.
CK-220.evidence: The IGT Hanging Rack 2 Frame is a stainless steel storage accessory for the Iron Grill Table System .

CK-230.note: Hangs off an edge, below the surface.
CK-230.evidence: The Shallow IGT Hanging Shelf is a single-shelf system compatible with IGT Frames.

CK-151.note: Joins two touching tables standing at DIFFERENT heights.
CK-151.evidence: Built to last, the IGT Height Adjusters allow for integration of different table heights.

LV-312.note: Drops a frame INTO the length of another table.
LV-312.evidence: The Stainless Kitchen Table IGT Frame Connector attaches to the Stainless Steel Kitchen Table to allow the insertion of an IGT Four Unit Frame within the length of the table.

CK-300.note: Clamps onto a rail. Consumes no slot.
CK-300.evidence: The TTA Unit Clamp Tool is a component of the IGT system and the foundational component of the TTA series.

CK-301.note: Clamps onto a rail. Consumes no slot.
CK-301.evidence: To use, insert each of the flange hooks into two TTA Clamp tools and adjust the tension.

CK-303.note: Clamps onto a rail. Consumes no slot.
CK-303.evidence: To use, connect the frame ends into two TTA Clamp Tools and adjust the tension.

CK-306.note: Clamps onto a rail. Consumes no slot.
CK-306.evidence: Please note: The TTA Frame & TTA Clamp Tool are required for assembly and are sold separately.

BG-032.note: Drops into the unit slots, between the two rails.
BG-032.evidence: Insert into any IGT Frame to fill 2 units of space or use as independent storage.

CK-026.note: Drops into the unit slots, between the two rails.
CK-026.evidence: Made of stainless steel, the IGT Stainless Steel Half Unit Tray is a sturdy half-unit surface that can be inserted into an IGT setup to create additional surface space for cooking or storage.

CK-125TR.note: Drops into the unit slots, between the two rails.
CK-125TR.evidence: The single-unit insert fits easily into three unit and four unit frames and features a small notch for quick removal.

CK-126TR.note: Drops into the unit slots, between the two rails.
CK-126TR.evidence: The double-unit insert fits easily into three unit and four unit frames and features a small notch for quick removal.

CK-225.note: Hangs off an edge, below the surface.
CK-225.evidence: The Mesh Tray can be inserted into the IGT Frame or the Hanging Rack Frame to provide ample storage for your outdoor kitchen.

CK-226.note: Drops into the unit slots, between the two rails.
CK-226.evidence: To use, insert into an IGT frame or slide into the TTA Frame and adjust the tension of the TTA Clamp Tool.

CK-250.note: Hangs off an edge, below the surface.
CK-250.evidence: The Mesh Tray can be inserted into any IGT Frame or the Hanging Rack Frame to provide extra storage space or as a drying rack.

CK-251.note: Drops into the unit slots, between the two rails.
CK-251.evidence: To use, insert into an IGT frame or slide into the TTA Frame and adjust the tension of the TTA Clamp Tool.

UG-471.note: Drops into the unit slots, between the two rails.
UG-471.evidence: The Waterproof Unit Gear Bag 110 easily inserts into any IGT frame for a single unit storage or wash option.

UG-472.note: Drops into the unit slots, between the two rails.
UG-472.evidence: The Waterproof Unit Gear Bag 220 easily inserts into any IGT frame for a single unit storage or wash option.

CK-080R.note: Drops into the unit slots, between the two rails.
CK-080R.evidence: Add preferred inserts into the three units of space or simply use with the included bamboo surfaces as a standalone table.

CK-080R-EC.note: Drops into the unit slots, between the two rails.
CK-080R-EC.evidence: Add preferred inserts into the three units of space or simply use with the included bamboo surfaces as a standalone table.

CK-090.note: A table in its own right; joins the layout as a node.
CK-090.evidence: The table has a minimalistic design that does not require any connection tools or extension pieces.
